contract.primary_gate: empty and exactly 128-byte payload values remain visible through append, query, count, reopen, and query-after-reopen
contract.secondary_gate: schema-aware diff treats payload value differences as strict behavior differences

must_hold: The fixture appends one empty TSDB payload.
The fixture appends one exactly 128-byte ASCII payload.
Full-range query reports both payloads without truncation.
Exact timestamp query reports only the 128-byte payload entry.
Empty range query reports no entries and written count 0.
Reopen preserves both visible payload values.
Schema-aware diff rejects mutated payload values.
must_not_claim: native FlashDB clean or GC semantics
